synthesizedPoints: Bridged Vipul's extensive Databricks and cloud ecosystem background directly to AT&T's requirement for production-grade Databricks application development and Azure/Snowflake integration.
Highlighted hands-on AI engineering and MLOps capabilities, mapping his autonomous anomaly detection, predictive ML, and agentic workflows to enterprise AI reliability standards.
Demonstrated robust data pipeline and ETL architecture experience using Spark, PySpark, ADF, and Snowflake to support high-throughput analytics and AI workloads.
